title: LLM Detoxification via Transition-Aware Reward-Guided Representation Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2610.41165v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can generate toxic content, motivating effective test-time detoxification. Existing representation steering methods often rely on static or coarse interventions and provide imprecise guidance because they inadequately model transitions between toxic and non-toxic generations. We propose Transition-Aware Reward-Guided Representation Sampling (TARGRS), a test-time framework that learns reward guidance over toxicity transitions in latent representation space. During exploration, progressive steering along the toxicity direction constructs trajectories from non-toxic to toxic states. Toxicity scores along these trajectories turn sparse annotations into dense, listwise supervision for a transition-aware token-level reward model. During inference, TARGRS uses this model to guide coarse-to-fine sampling along the opposite, non-toxic direction: coarse sampling identifies the intervention needed to reach non-toxic reg

translated_title: 基于转换感知奖励引导表示采样的大语言模型去毒化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）可能生成有毒内容，因此需要有效的测试时去毒化方法。现有的表示引导方法通常依赖静态或粗粒度的干预，并且由于未能充分建模有毒生成与无毒生成之间的转换，提供的引导不够精确。我们提出了转换感知奖励引导表示采样（TARGRS），这是一个在潜在表示空间中学习针对毒性转换的奖励引导的测试时框架。在探索阶段，沿毒性方向进行渐进式引导，构建从无毒状态到有毒状态的轨迹。沿这些轨迹的毒性评分将稀疏标注转化为密集的列表式监督，用于训练转换感知的词元级奖励模型。在推理阶段，TARGRS 利用该模型沿相反的无毒方向引导由粗到细的采样：粗采样确定到达无毒区域所需的干预……
tldr: 该论文提出TARGRS框架，通过在潜在表示空间中学习毒性转换上的词元级奖励模型，在推理时沿无毒方向进行由粗到细的表示采样，从而实现大语言模型的有效测试时去毒化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TARGRS, a test-time framework that learns a transition-aware token-level reward model over toxicity transitions in latent representation space and uses it to guide coarse-to-fine sampling along the non-toxic direction for effective LLM detoxification.
